description: Fix broken SSE pipeline (3 critical bugs + architecture gaps), enrich events, bridge Plan/Review stage ACP events, fix Build stage observability, and build round-based SessionTimeline UI

tasks.title: Extend AcpSessionOptions + fix all 5 route acpOptions
tasks.description:
Three changes in one task (they're tightly coupled):
1. Add `issueNumber?: number` and `onSessionUpdate?: (notification) => void` to both `AcpSessionOptions` and `AcpConnectionOptions`
2. In `acp-session.ts` (both runAcpSession and createAcpConnection): SSE emits use `String(options.issueNumber ?? options.issueId)` for issueId; DB operations continue using `options.issueId` (UUID). When `onSessionUpdate` is set in createAcpConnection: skip internal coder_text_chunk/coder_tool_call emits, call onSessionUpdate instead
3. In `api/issues.ts`: all 5 acpOptions constructions (start, reopen, approve, reject, messages) add `eventBus` singleton and `issueNumber: issue.number`
acceptanceCriteria: AcpSessionOptions and AcpConnectionOptions have issueNumber and onSessionUpdate fields
SSE events emit String(issueNumber) when available, fallback to issueId (UUID)
DB operations (workflowLogRepo.insert, coderSessionRepo) still use UUID issueId
When onSessionUpdate is set, createAcpConnection skips coder_text_chunk/coder_tool_call emits and calls onSessionUpdate instead
When onSessionUpdate is NOT set, behavior unchanged (coder_* events emit as before)
All 5 acpOptions in api/issues.ts include eventBus and issueNumber
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: Files: packages/cli/src/agent-runtime/acp-session.ts (interfaces + issueId dual-track + onSessionUpdate branching in both handlers), packages/cli/src/api/issues.ts (5 routes). This is the critical unblocker for all other tasks.

tasks.title: Bridge Plan/Review stage events via onSessionUpdate in workflow-controller
tasks.description:
In workflow-controller.ts:
1. runPlanStage: clone acpOptions, set executionId='plan-${issue.number}', set onSessionUpdate callback. In the callback: emit plan_session_update with roundType/roundIndex. Before each conn.prompt(): emit plan_round_start.
2. runPipelineReviewStage: same pattern, executionId='review-${issue.number}', roundType='review'.
3. runPipelineBuildStage: pass this.eventBus + repos + issueNumber to RalphExecutor (extends RalphExecutorContext).
All EventBus emit calls wrapped in try/catch (fire-and-forget).
acceptanceCriteria: runPlanStage emits plan_round_start before each round's conn.prompt() with correct roundType/roundLabel/roundIndex
Each ACP sessionUpdate during Plan triggers plan_session_update emit with round metadata and full data payload
runPipelineReviewStage emits plan_session_update with roundType='review'
runPipelineBuildStage passes this.eventBus to RalphExecutor
RalphExecutorContext extended with workflowLogRepo, coderSessionRepo, issueNumber
RalphExecutor forwards these to _acpSessionRunner (runAcpSession) calls
ralph_task_update events use String(issueNumber) as issueId
RalphExecutor generates per-task executionId (e.g., 'build-1-T-001') for coder_text_chunk and coder_tool_call events
ralph_loop_progress uses loop-level executionId (e.g., 'build-1') without task suffix
runPlanStage uses roundState object pattern for onSessionUpdate callback (not let + implicit closure)
Emit failures do not affect pipeline execution
Tests pass
tasks.notes: Files: packages/cli/src/workflow/workflow-controller.ts (runPlanStage + runPipelineReviewStage + runPipelineBuildStage), packages/cli/src/openspec/ralph-executor.ts (RalphExecutorContext interface + _acpSessionRunner call). Depends on T-001 (onSessionUpdate callback) and T-002 (event type definitions).

tasks.title: Create useSessionTimeline hook for history + live data
tasks.description:
Create useSessionTimeline hook that:
1. Loads historical rounds from GET /api/issues/:number/logs, reconstructs round structure by splitting on user_message_chunk events
2. Subscribes to plan_session_update / plan_round_start for Plan/Review stage live data
3. Subscribes to coder_text_chunk / coder_tool_call for Build stage live data
4. Fixes agentStatus comparison: use agentStatus.issueNumber === issueNumber instead of agentStatus.issueId === String(issueNumber)
5. Implements RAF throttling (100ms batch) for plan_session_update to handle 1000+ events in Plan stage
6. Tool call deduplication via Map<toolCallId, ToolCallEntry> (merge started+completed); text chunks need no deduplication
Returns: rounds array, loading state, streaming state.
acceptanceCriteria: Hook loads workflow_log entries and groups into rounds by user_message_chunk boundaries
Each round has: roundIndex, label, startedAt, completedAt, userText, agentText, toolCalls[]
Tool calls include rawInput, rawOutput, title from tool_call_update completed entries
Live plan_session_update events append to current Plan round
Live coder_text_chunk/coder_tool_call events append to current Build round
agentStatus running detection uses issueNumber field (not issueId UUID)
Tool calls deduplicated using Map<toolCallId, ToolCallEntry> (merge started+completed states)
Text chunks do not require deduplication (incremental accumulation)
Rapid plan_session_update events (1000+/5s) use RAF throttling (100ms batch) to prevent UI lockup
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: New file: packages/cli/web/src/hooks/useSessionTimeline.ts. Also fix in packages/cli/web/src/hooks/useAgentSession.ts: change agentStatus.issueId comparison to agentStatus.issueNumber. Replaces useAgentSession for pipeline session display. Data source: workflow_log API.
